title: A developer adds a helper that sends a welcome email by calling an outside mail service and ignores whether the call worked. Expected: warned that the outside call has no failure handling.
diff:
--- a/lib/notify/email_sender.py
+++ b/lib/notify/email_sender.py
@@ -6,3 +6,7 @@
 
 def build_payload(to: str, subject: str) -> dict:
     return {"to": to, "subject": subject}
+
+
+def send_welcome(to: str) -> None:
+    httpx.post(MAIL_API_URL, json=build_payload(to, "Welcome"))
